moments.explanation: Dexter carries the bagged body down the dock and loads it onto his boat. Every disposal of his opens this way, and none has gone wrong yet.

evidence.note: Dexter carries the bags down the dock to the boat.

moments.explanation: Told by everyone to drop it, Doakes tails Dexter all the way into the Everglades. It is the only line that catches him with the evidence.

evidence.note: Doakes steps out of the reeds with his gun drawn.

moments.explanation: Doakes has the gun, the evidence and the angle, and spends the moment grinning. Every second he talks is a second Dexter spends planning.

evidence.note: Long close-up of Doakes grinning down the barrel.

moments.explanation: Dexter stands still by the boat with his hands where Doakes can see them. A nervous man with a gun gets nothing to react to.

evidence.note: Dexter stands still by the boat.

moments.explanation: Dexter kneels slowly and obeys every order, looking finished. The surrender lowers Doakes' guard and walks Dexter toward the gun.
Doakes lets Dexter walk up holding the cuffs, inside arm's reach of the gun. One lunge and the arrest is over.

evidence.note: Dexter steps forward holding the cuffs.
